integrity: Exact combinatorial proof of the all-length claim, independently checked by a direct Boolean simulator and a boundary-word enumerator; computations are supporting finite checks, not infinite certification. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Initial exact period-two configurations only; not full basins or fixed states. The uniform entropy holds for all chord distances; the universal prefactor requires both arc lengths diverge. Complete 1980 Goles–Olivos text was not accessible; equivalent historical formulations remain a residual priority risk.
title: Chord-distance formula and bulk universality for majority two-cycles on singly chorded rings
